FooterModal.DeliveryEstimateText: The estimated delivery time for the selected configuration is shown in the order. It is an estimate, not a guaranteed date. PCWerk will confirm it after reviewing the order.
FooterModal.DeliverySuppliersText: Delivery time depends on stock levels, processing times, and transport by component suppliers and partner stores in Switzerland. Delays, shortages, or product discontinuation may affect the schedule. We will inform you and, if necessary, propose a comparable replacement at the same or a lower price.
FooterModal.DeliveryProcessText: Submitting an order does not initiate an online payment and does not constitute an unconditional commitment to deliver. We first check compatibility, prices, and availability, then confirm the final price, delivery, and payment by email. For component-only orders, delivery and warranty may be handled by the partner store.
FooterModal.DeliveryReceiptText: Inspect the shipment immediately upon receipt and report any visible damage or missing items without delay. If the delivery date changes significantly, contact us for updated information and available options.
FooterModal.Terms1Text: These terms apply to orders and services from PCWerk, {0}, Switzerland. Individual written agreements and the final confirmation take precedence.
FooterModal.Terms2Text: Configuring and submitting an order constitutes a non-binding inquiry. No online payment is collected. A contract is concluded only after the configuration, final price, availability, delivery, and payment have been confirmed by email.
FooterModal.Terms3Text: Prices and availability are based on current supplier offers and may change before confirmation. If a component is unavailable, PCWerk may propose a technically comparable replacement at the same or a lower price. Any material change requires the customer’s consent.
FooterModal.Terms4Text: The scope depends on the type of order. PCWerk manually checks compatibility. If you choose assembly by PCWerk, we perform the agreed assembly, configuration, and testing. For component-only orders, the customer orders from partner stores, assembly is not included in the service, and delivery and warranty are handled by the respective store.
FooterModal.Terms5Text: Payment terms and the final invoice are provided separately by email. The delivery time stated in the order depends on availability and supplier processing times in Switzerland. Details are provided in the delivery policy.
FooterModal.Terms6Text: The order may be cancelled by email at no additional cost within 12 hours. After that, verification begins, and a CHF 49 fee is charged for the compatibility check performed if the order is cancelled later.
FooterModal.Terms7Text: The customer should inspect the goods and report defects without delay. Statutory rights and any manufacturer or retailer warranties apply. PCWerk has unlimited liability for intent, gross negligence, and cases in which exclusion of liability is not permitted. In all other cases, liability is limited to foreseeable, direct damage resulting from a breach of contract.
FooterModal.Terms8Text: Swiss law applies, subject to mandatory consumer-protection provisions. Jurisdiction is determined by mandatory legal provisions. Questions and notices: {1}.
FooterModal.Privacy1Text: The controller is PCWerk, {0}, Switzerland. Contact: {1}, {2}.
FooterModal.Privacy2Text: When you configure or place an order, we process the contact and delivery details you provide, order and configuration details, messages, and technical data needed for the operation and security of the website, such as IP address, device information, and logs.
FooterModal.Privacy3Text: We use the data to handle inquiries, review and fulfill orders, verify compatibility, issue invoices, arrange delivery, provide support, prevent abuse, and comply with legal obligations. Processing is based on pre-contractual measures, performance of a contract, legal obligations, a legitimate interest in the secure operation of the website, or consent where required.
FooterModal.Privacy4Text: Data is shared only with necessary hosting, email, payment, or accounting providers, carriers, and Swiss component suppliers and partner stores. Service providers use the data only for the agreed purpose. Where data is transferred abroad, we apply the required safeguards.
FooterModal.Privacy5Text: Order and accounting data is retained for the period required by law. Other data is retained only as long as necessary for the relevant purpose or to pursue claims. We use appropriate technical and organizational measures, although data transmission over the internet is not entirely risk-free.
FooterModal.Privacy6Text: Under Swiss law, you may request access to your data, correction, deletion, restriction of processing, or data portability; withdraw consent with future effect; object to processing; and contact the data-protection authority. Requests: {1}.
